articles.title: JPMorgan Explains Why $85K Level Is Crucial for Bitcoin (BTC)
articles.description: JPMorgan says Bitcoin’s brief move above the crucial $85,000 production-cost level could ease pressure on miners after BTC spent a staggering 280 days below it.

articles.title: Bitcoin Holds Steady as ONDO Gains Amid US Treasury Yield Surge
articles.description: Bitcoin’s performance during US hours was marked by sharp interest-rate-driven swings, as the yield on the US 10-year Treasury note pushed to its highest

articles.title: Decade High as BTC Steadies and ONDO Rallies
articles.description: Bitcoin trades near $84,000 as the US 10-year Treasury yield hits its highest level since 2007, while Ondo’s ONDO token rallies to reclaim $0.50.

articles.title: Strive Outpaces Saylor's Strategy With $86 Million Bitcoin Treasury Push
articles.description: Strive raised $85.88 million via three SATA sessions between Sept. 21 and Sept. 23, adding roughly 1,001 Bitcoin and widening the gap with Michael Saylor's Strategy.

articles.title: Bitcoin Price Prediction: $90K BTC Needs Billions More While AlphaPepe Nears $2.8M With Its First Big Run Still Ahead
articles.description: Bitcoin blasted above $86,000 and dragged $90,000 directly into the firing line. The market giant is one hard move away from the target, but pushing an asset this enormous even a few percentage points requires billions of fresh dollars.

articles.title: Strive raises $86M through SATA as Bitcoin treasury buying continues
articles.description: Strive’s SATA tracker estimates $85.88 million raised over three sessions, enough for about 1,002 BTC, as investors await the next company filing.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s $85K rally started with ETFs, but leverage is rising
articles.description: Bitcoin’s $85K rally began with ETF inflows, BTCS adviser Wojciech Kaszycki says, but rising futures leverage puts the next move under scrutiny.

articles.title: Macro headwinds push Bitcoin to $82.9K despite historical 365
articles.description: Historical data shows bitcoin posted long-term gains after regaining its 365-day trendline following extended slumps, though analysts caution the pattern is not foolproof.

articles.title: Sequans Drops Bitcoin Treasury Plan After Selling Remaining 314 BTC
articles.description: French semiconductor company Sequans Communications has fully exited its Bitcoin treasury strategy, selling its remaining 314 BTC and leaving the firm

articles.title: Pete Hegseth reports at least $3.1 million, investments, bitcoin
articles.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth reported at least $3.1 million in assets as he faces an impeachment push in Congress over his handling of the Iran war.
